title: TCSMP
description: TCSMP a Minecraft mini games/survival server
body:
this is a simple survival server in our survival world you are not allowed to break or steal from chests from anybody's builds that are near spawn unless it's secret but if you build far from spawn people are allowed to break and steal from you

and we have an entire economy system and a /shop and /sell cmd
